title: Anion–π interaction and solvent dehydrogenation control enable high-voltage lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03027C, Paper
Tao Zhou, Jinze Wang, Ling Lv, Ruhong Li, Long Chen, Shuoqing Zhang, Haikuo Zhang, Baochen Ma, Jiajie Huang, Bing Wu, Lixin Chen, Tao Deng, Xiulin Fan
The electrolyte additive BFBN exhibits a repulsive interaction with EC and an attractive interaction with PF6−, suppressing EC dehydrogenation and facilitating the formation of anion-derived LiF-rich CEI.
